geometry_analysis.width_description: Indeterminate/Disrupted; the lateral edges of the weld bead are severely compromised by surface-breaking voids, making accurate width measurement impossible along the central axis
geometry_analysis.surface_profile: Discontinuous; the weld face is collapsed and riddled with deep cavities, lacking a coherent reinforcement profile
geometry_analysis.linearity: General longitudinal alignment is straight, though the bead integrity is broken

visual_anomalies.visual_description: Extensive, interconnected network of large, elongated, and deep cavities (vermicular porosity) covering the majority of the weld face
visual_anomalies.visual_severity: Catastrophic; the defect density creates a sponge-like or honeycomb appearance, compromising the entire volume visible

visual_anomalies.visual_description: Large, deep, round cavity specifically located at the weld termination

surface_state.spatter_distribution: Fine metallic particles scattered on the adjacent base metal
surface_state.discoloration: Internal surfaces of the voids appear dark/shadowed; some oxidation visible on the remaining metallic bridges
